in_sanskrit.name: मन्तोष
in_sanskrit.meaning: Delighting mind, Fulfilling mind, Desiring mind, Mindful, Satisfied
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Mantosh is derived from the Sanskrit word मन्तोष (mantoshaḥ), which is composed of the roots मन् (manaḥ) meaning mind and तोष (toshaḥ) meaning delight, satisfaction, fulfillment. The name can be interpreted as one who delights the mind, fulfills the mind, or is mindful and satisfied.

in_hindi.name: मन्तोष
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Mantosh in Hindi is written as मन्तोष (mantoṣ). The meaning of the name is मन के प्रसन्न (man ke prasann), which translates to 'delighted mind' or 'satisfied mind' in English.

in_tamil.name: மந்தோஷ
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Mantosh in Tamil is written as மந்தோஷ (manthōṣ). The meaning of the name is அழித்தல் பிரியம், அழித்தல் மனம் (aziththal piriyam, aziththal manam), which translates to 'desiring mind, fulfilling mind' in English.

in_telugu.name: మంటోష
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Mantosh in Telugu is written as మంటోష (maṇṭōṣ). The meaning of the name is మనదేహేది, మనదేహేదిపోయినది (manadehēdi, manadehēdipōyindi), which translates to 'mindful, satisfied mind' in English.

in_marathi.name: Mantosh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mantosh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from Sanskrit words ‘manas’ meaning mind and ‘tosh’ meaning delight or pleasure, Mantosh signifies God's gift to parents, symbolizing the joy and blessings bestowed upon them.

in_bengali.name: Mantosh
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God's gift
